treaties.summary: The Mainland-Hong Kong income arrangement and Mainland-Singapore agreement have original, protocol and selected MLI-related records. Other listed partners are not thereby fully archived.
treaties.caveat: A treaty directory is not the treaty text; protocols and tax-effective dates require their own links.

residence_pe.summary: Effective-management residence, service presence and treaty PE conditions have distinct fact inputs and judgement paths.
residence_pe.caveat: Incorporation, tax residence, where services occur and whether a PE exists are not interchangeable facts.

transfer_pricing.summary: Cross-border pricing adjustments, documentation obligations and financing deduction limits have separate rules.
transfer_pricing.caveat: The arm's-length price itself must be supported by facts; the engine does not perform an independent benchmarking study.

anti_avoidance_substance.summary: GAAR, beneficial-owner factors, commercial purpose and treaty PPT are linked to rules and selected official cases.
anti_avoidance_substance.caveat: Documentary factors do not automatically establish favourable authority acceptance.

intellectual_property.summary: Licence royalties, know-how classification, ownership transfers and technology-transfer relief are distinct treatments.
intellectual_property.caveat: A licence is not an ownership sale; registration and recognition conditions must be checked before claiming technology relief.

surcharges.summary: City maintenance and construction tax and local education surcharge are tied to their own modelled VAT bases and bearer rules.
surcharges.caveat: A surcharge rate is not another corporate income-tax rate; import and withholding scope matter.

loss_relief.summary: Standard and specified extended carryforwards, foreign-loss limits and branch-loss treatment are represented separately.
loss_relief.caveat: A general carryforward period must not replace the conditions for special taxpayer or loss-year regimes.

administration.summary: Return forms, resident certificates, withholding, refund, administrative review and MAP have separate evidence and timing rules.
administration.caveat: Payment, first notification and assessment dates can start different clocks; use the relevant dated rule.

corporate_law.summary: No general Mainland corporate-registration or migration procedure model is established; tax reorganisation rules remain a separate topic.
corporate_law.caveat: Tax treatment alone does not establish that a proposed corporate transaction is legally implementable.

corporate_income.summary: Resident enterprise income tax has a headline rate; entity-specific rates, deductions and incentives require their own facts.
corporate_income.caveat: The headline rate is not an effective tax rate or a rate for every company.

personal_income.summary: Some multi-tax documents mention individuals. A systematic personal-income dictionary and individual calculation model have not been built.
personal_income.caveat: Incidental collection is not comprehensive personal tax coverage.

inheritance_estate_gift.summary: No dedicated inheritance / estate / gift tax inventory or calculation model is established in this catalogue.
inheritance_estate_gift.caveat: This states a collection gap, not a legal conclusion that such taxes exist or do not exist.

exit_tax.summary: Exit / migration taxation is not a separately established coverage area. Share sale and reorganisation material is catalogued under its own topics.
exit_tax.caveat: A tax on a share disposal is not automatically an exit tax.

cfc.summary: Company CFC inclusion, control thresholds, low-tax conditions and specified exceptions are represented by parameters and rules.
cfc.caveat: The low-tax parameter is a percentage of the statutory corporate rate, not a standalone tax rate. Business-need and active-income determinations can remain judgemental.

withholding.summary: A domestic non-resident income-tax rate and transaction-specific source, treaty and base rules are indexed.
withholding.caveat: Do not apply the domestic rate to every service payment; source, establishment, treaty and classification conditions matter.

foreign_income_credit.summary: Foreign income charging, direct / indirect credits and carryforwards are modelled for company scenarios.
foreign_income_credit.caveat: Tax paid is not automatically tax creditable; entitlement and limits are separate.

capital_gains.summary: Direct and indirect share disposals, seller tax basis and treaty allocation have modelled rules.
capital_gains.caveat: The consideration, gain and withholding amount are different concepts; treaty conditions must be checked.

restructuring_distributions.summary: Reorganisation, reinvestment, capitalisation, capital reduction and liquidation have scenario-specific rules.
restructuring_distributions.caveat: Thresholds are only some of the requirements for a particular reorganisation treatment.

vat_gst.summary: VAT parameters distinguish services, tangible leases, goods and property, with commencement dates retained.
vat_gst.caveat: These are transaction-specific examples, not one universal VAT rate. Pre-commencement transactions may fall outside the retained library.

stamp_duty.summary: Equity-transfer stamp duty is indexed separately from income tax and treaty rate caps.
stamp_duty.caveat: The listed share-transfer parameter is not the rate for every instrument.

property_taxes.summary: Property transfer, letting, property tax, land appreciation tax and deed tax have separate rule families.
property_taxes.caveat: Separate taxes and different tax bases must not be collapsed into a single property tax percentage.

customs.summary: The current engine contains goods / customs rule families; tariff classification and the specific transaction still determine applicability.
customs.caveat: This is not a complete tariff schedule or a general customs advisory system.

pillar_two.summary: The model can involve Mainland companies in cross-border minimum-tax calculations. This does not itself establish a domestic Mainland top-up tax.
pillar_two.caveat: The existence of a group threshold in a computation is not evidence that the same domestic regime exists in every jurisdiction.

treaties.summary: The Mainland-Hong Kong arrangement is indexed with language and protocol versions. The Hong Kong-Singapore records cover limited airline / shipping income.
treaties.caveat: Do not use limited transport coverage as a general treaty cap on dividends, interest or royalties.

residence_pe.summary: Profits source, recipient residence certificates and treaty PE issues are indexed as separate questions, with selected source-of-profits precedents.
residence_pe.caveat: A Hong Kong bank receipt or incorporation record alone does not settle the profits-source analysis.

transfer_pricing.summary: Pricing adjustments, deduction limits and local / master file requirements have specific company and transaction conditions.
transfer_pricing.caveat: Documentation exemptions and an arm's-length result are separate tests.

anti_avoidance_substance.summary: FSIE substance, beneficial ownership and treaty anti-abuse conditions are separately indexed; selected IRD rulings and judgments support fact analysis.
anti_avoidance_substance.caveat: A ruling for another applicant is not the current company's approval.

intellectual_property.summary: Royalty charging, IP ownership disposals and FSIE IP nexus conditions are separate rule families.
intellectual_property.caveat: Non-IP holding substance relief must not be applied automatically to IP income.

surcharges.summary: No dedicated VAT-related surcharge calculation family is indexed for Hong Kong.
surcharges.caveat: This records model coverage and does not establish the legal absence of all additional levies.

loss_relief.summary: Loss carryforward, Hong Kong activity scope and ownership-change conditions have model rules.
loss_relief.caveat: A loss ledger does not by itself establish that the loss is available against this income.

administration.summary: CoR, FSIE and profits-tax forms, objection / appeal and MAP materials are linked separately.
administration.caveat: The objection period is tied to its notice and the applicable procedural conditions, not the transaction date alone.

corporate_law.summary: Companies Registry re-domiciliation procedure material is indexed as supporting law.
corporate_law.caveat: A migration procedure source does not establish the full tax cost of departure, entry or subsequent transactions.

corporate_income.summary: Corporation profits tax has a standard rate and a separately indexed first tier; profits-source and eligibility conditions remain important.
corporate_income.caveat: The first-tier rate is conditional; it must not replace the standard rate for the entire tax base.

personal_income.summary: The archived Inland Revenue Ordinance is a mixed-scope statute. A systematic personal / salaries-tax dictionary and individual calculation model are not implemented.
personal_income.caveat: A whole ordinance in the corpus is not equivalent to complete personal-tax coverage.

inheritance_estate_gift.summary: No dedicated inheritance / estate / gift tax inventory or calculation model is established in this catalogue.
inheritance_estate_gift.caveat: An empty category must not be displayed as a zero tax rate.

exit_tax.summary: Re-domiciliation procedure material exists, but it is not a complete exit / migration tax inventory.
exit_tax.caveat: Company registration procedures and migration taxation are separate subjects.

cfc.summary: No dedicated Hong Kong CFC calculation rule is indexed. Foreign-sourced income and substance rules are classified separately.
cfc.caveat: No indexed CFC rule is not proof of a legal absence of CFC or other anti-deferral measures.

withholding.summary: The model explicitly distinguishes outbound dividends / interest from royalty and other taxable situations.
withholding.caveat: The cited NOCHARGE rule is scoped to the stated income and side, not a declaration that all cross-border payments are tax free.

foreign_income_credit.summary: FSIE distinguishes covered foreign income, receipt, substance, participation and IP conditions; credit rules are linked separately.
foreign_income_credit.caveat: The thresholds are not a blanket exemption; entity, receipt, subject-to-tax and anti-abuse conditions remain relevant.

capital_gains.summary: Capital / revenue character, onshore disposal certainty and foreign disposal income are separate rule routes.
capital_gains.caveat: Do not summarise all share gains as automatically untaxed.

restructuring_distributions.summary: Specific stamp-duty and FSIE intragroup provisions are represented, alongside scenario-specific unwind steps.
restructuring_distributions.caveat: An intragroup relationship does not by itself establish relief.

vat_gst.summary: No VAT / GST calculation family or dedicated non-charge evidence is indexed under this topic.
vat_gst.caveat: This catalogue does not infer the legal absence of a tax from the absence of a rule.

stamp_duty.summary: Stock-transfer stamp duty is catalogued separately from profits tax; property instruments have their own rules.
stamp_duty.caveat: The cited stock parameter does not describe the entire property duty schedule.

property_taxes.summary: Property-tax rate, statutory allowance and set-off parameters are indexed separately from profits tax and property-transfer duties.
property_taxes.caveat: The allowance percentage and tax rate use different bases and must not be added.

customs.summary: No dedicated Hong Kong customs calculation family is established in the current engine catalogue.
customs.caveat: No rule does not establish a zero duty for a specific product.

pillar_two.summary: Hong Kong minimum-tax and group-rule material is collected, with modelled parameters and judgement-dependent conditions.
pillar_two.caveat: Group thresholds, fiscal years, entity exclusions and the relevant domestic or income-inclusion rule must be checked separately.

treaties.summary: The Singapore-China agreement has consolidated, protocol and MLI material. Hong Kong-Singapore material is limited to transport; the IRAS partner list is a directory, not a full archive of every treaty.
treaties.caveat: Agreement scope and version must be confirmed before applying a treaty rate cap.

residence_pe.summary: Company tax residence / CoR, source of income and treaty PE conditions are separately represented, with source-of-income cases.
residence_pe.caveat: Receipt in Singapore, company residence and source of income are distinct questions.

transfer_pricing.summary: Arm's-length adjustments, documentation and the associated surcharge have separate rules and source parameters.
transfer_pricing.caveat: A supplied contract price is not automatically an independently verified arm's-length price.

anti_avoidance_substance.summary: Treaty PPT, capital / revenue character and foreign-income substance conditions can require fact-sensitive determinations.
anti_avoidance_substance.caveat: Unknown treatment remains a condition; another taxpayer's ruling is not automatic clearance.

intellectual_property.summary: Rights-based software payment classification, royalty treatment, IP disposals and allowances are distinguished.
intellectual_property.caveat: The rights actually acquired and prior deduction history matter; a contract label alone does not determine the result.

surcharges.summary: No dedicated VAT-related surcharge calculation family is indexed for Singapore; GST and transfer-pricing surcharge topics are distinct.
surcharges.caveat: A missing model family is not a legal zero-rate finding.

loss_relief.summary: Loss continuity, shareholder tests, waiver and group-relief conditions have separate parameters and rules.
loss_relief.caveat: Carryforward and group relief are different routes and require their own qualifying facts.

administration.summary: S45 withholding forms and clocks, CoR, foreign-tax-credit workpapers, objection and MAP procedures are linked separately.
administration.caveat: The catalogue identifies one official-calculator practice rule separately from statutory text.

corporate_law.summary: Transfer-of-registration provisions under the Companies Act are indexed as supporting procedure material.
corporate_law.caveat: Transfer of registration does not itself establish comprehensive exit / entry taxation coverage.

corporate_income.summary: The company income-tax headline rate is indexed; exemptions and rebates need their own company and assessment-year facts.
corporate_income.caveat: The headline rate is not a company's final effective tax rate.

personal_income.summary: The archived Income Tax Act is mixed-scope. Individual tax bands, reliefs and a personal-tax calculation model are not systematically represented.
personal_income.caveat: Whole-Act collection is not complete personal-tax coverage.

inheritance_estate_gift.summary: No dedicated inheritance / estate / gift tax inventory or calculation model is established in this catalogue.
inheritance_estate_gift.caveat: This is a collection status, not a conclusion about present or historical estate-duty law.

exit_tax.summary: Company transfer-of-registration material is available, but a complete exit / migration tax inventory is not established.
exit_tax.caveat: Share-disposal taxation and re-domiciliation procedures must not be relabelled as a complete exit-tax regime.

cfc.summary: No dedicated Singapore CFC calculation rule is indexed. Foreign-income, disposal-gain and substance rules are represented separately.
cfc.caveat: The absence of a CFC rule in this engine does not establish a legal absence of all anti-deferral measures.

withholding.summary: Domestic non-resident interest and royalty parameters are indexed with their statutory conditions; outbound dividends have an explicit model rule.
withholding.caveat: Interest and royalty rates depend on recipient, business / establishment and treaty conditions; do not compare them as unconditional effective rates.

foreign_income_credit.summary: Foreign-income receipt and exemption conditions, unilateral / treaty credits and pooling are separately represented.
foreign_income_credit.caveat: A foreign headline-rate test is different from the tax actually paid on the income.

capital_gains.summary: Capital / revenue character, section 13W certainty and section 10L foreign disposal gains are separate rule routes.
capital_gains.caveat: Date, asset and group conditions matter; do not describe all disposal gains as exempt.

restructuring_distributions.summary: Specific stamp relief, asset-transfer conditions and scenario distributions are represented where the model has matching rules.
restructuring_distributions.caveat: Complete reorganisation tax treatment cannot be inferred from a single stamp-duty relief provision.

vat_gst.summary: GST rate, reverse charge and recovery parameters are indexed.
vat_gst.caveat: Whether GST is charged or recoverable depends on the supply and taxpayer's facts.

stamp_duty.summary: Share-transfer stamp duty is distinct from property duty and additional-duty schedules.
stamp_duty.caveat: The share-transfer parameter is not a universal stamp-duty rate.

property_taxes.summary: Non-residential and residential property-tax schedules are separately parameterised.
property_taxes.caveat: The displayed non-residential rate must not be applied to all residential property.

customs.summary: No dedicated Singapore customs calculation family is established in the current engine catalogue.
customs.caveat: A goods-income rule is not a complete customs tariff model.

pillar_two.summary: Minimum-tax statute, regulations, domestic top-up and income-inclusion material have parameter and rule links.
pillar_two.caveat: Group revenue, fiscal-year and GloBE facts are required; a nominal threshold alone does not determine liability.
